correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed Hom(K2,KG(5,2)) from ordered complete bipartite vertex-set cells. Square-freeness excludes cells with both sides of size >1. The twenty maximal 2-simplices (ten fixed-left and ten fixed-right) have empty same-side pair intersections, single-vertex cross intersections for exactly thirty ordered adjacent pairs, and no triple intersections. Their S5-equivariant Cech comparison with the 20-vertex, 30-edge Desargues double cover identifies integral homology with ker(partial[e_A,B]=[B,1]-[A,0]), not merely abstract Betti numbers. Connectedness follows from a Petersen five-cycle, giving free rank 30-20+1=11 and no higher reduced homology. S5 permutes oriented edges without reversal; character is fixed edges minus twice fixed Petersen vertices plus one. An independent all-120-permutation enumeration reproduced class traces (11,-1,-1,-1,-1,1,1) and the rational Specht summands (3,1,1) and (2,2,1) through Young-module cancellation; 6+5=11. This does not assert integral splitting or source-vertex-swap equivariance.
